itemalchemy-expansion.config.title: Item Alchemy Expansion Config
itemalchemy-expansion.config.experimenta: These features are still in testing and may affect EMC calculation.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.displayMode:
How items appear in extract slots.
Icon only / Name only / Icon + Name (default).
itemalchemy-expansion.config.searchByTra: Search by both item ID and translated name.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.renderNameU: When Display Mode is Icon + Name, show item name under each extract slot.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerBoxM:
Enable: shulker boxes can be placed (contents count as EMC).
Disable: shulker boxes cannot be placed.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerNoEm:
How to handle shulker boxes with no-EMC items inside.
Reject: block placing.
Allow as zero: treat as 0 EMC, allow placing.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.builtInShul: Use built-in Shift-hover preview when ShulkerBoxTooltip is not installed.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.debugLoggin: Output detailed debug logs (variant keys, extract slots, registration). Enable for troubleshooting.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.fullIgnoreD: Ignore Damage and RepairCost so tools with different durability don't create many variants.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.ignoreNbtKe: NBT keys always excluded from fingerprints to avoid mismatch from runtime state changes. One per line.
itemalchemy-expansion.shulker_box.no_emc: Cannot place: %s has no EMC value. Set 'No-EMC Item Policy' to 'Allow as zero' to ignore.
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.title: Set Item EMC Value
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.scope.glob: Writes to global config, affects all saves
Store by variant; same ID with different NBT gets separate prices
Store by ID; all same-ID items share one price
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.fail.excep: Error while setting EMC, check logs
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.fail.shulk: Shulker boxes with contents cannot be manually priced; their EMC is auto-summed from contents
Checked = overwrite (remove precise price, unify with general); unchecked = keep precise price
Click row to toggle; scroll to list
itemalchemy-expansion.config.searchShulk: Also search inside shulker boxes. Matching boxes appear after direct items.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerMatc: Draw red frame around matching content slots during Shift preview.
itemalchemy-expansion.filter_button.tool:
Filter mode: click to cycle
All: direct items + shulker boxes
Items: direct items only
Box: shulker boxes only
itemalchemy-expansion.config.autoPricing:
Scan all recipes (including mod custom types) and auto-price undefined items by material EMC sum.
Manual EMC is not affected. On first enable, prompt whether to re-price already-set items.

How to pick a price when multiple recipes produce the same item.
Min: cheapest recipe (recommended)
Other options are not yet implemented.
Keep vanilla/upstream default EMC, don't override with auto-pricing. Recommended.

Max recipes processed per server tick during auto-pricing scan. Time-sliced to avoid lag.
Larger: faster first scan; smaller: smoother TPS.
Per-tick time budget for auto-pricing scan. Yields main thread when exceeded. Default 8ms balances scan speed and TPS.
Enable in Mod Menu -> Item Alchemy Expansion -> Experimental.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.title: Re-price Already-Set Items?
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.selective_: Checked = re-price automatically; unchecked = keep manual value
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.hint2: Run /itemalchemy-expansion reprice later to trigger again.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.feedback.k: [IAExp] Kept manual settings; auto-pricing will only handle undefined items.
